plan: With 3 bidders and uniform values on [0,49], the symmetric Nash equilibrium bidding strategy in a first-price auction is to bid (n-1)/n of your value, which equals 2/3 for n=3. This balances the trade-off between winning probability and profit margin. My value is $39, so I'll bid approximately 2/3 × 39 = $26. This maximizes expected profit given optimal competitor behavior.
